bhinno.g: ettha bhinne saṁghe gantvā karaṇīyaṁ natthi, yo pana “bhijjissatī”ti āsaṅkito, taṁ sandhāya “bhinno”ti vuttaṁ.

bhinno.l: Ettāvatā kho Upāli saṁgho bhinno hotī

bhinnattā.g: idaṁ dvayaṁ “sekkhoti puthujjanakalyāṇakena saddhiṁ satta ariyā, bhinnattāti iminā pana cattāro phalaṭṭhā”ti iminā dvayena na sameti, tadidaṁ nippariyāyadassanaṁ vuttanti veditabbaṁ.
